ToSpeech UK phoneme reference audio — attribution and licence notice

Newcastle University IPA Online
Creators: Ghada Khattab and Gerry Docherty; the bundled derivatives use the
female-speaker (GK) files. Recorded at Culture Lab, Newcastle University.
Source: https://teaching.ncl.ac.uk/ipa/
Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 2.0 UK: England & Wales
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/2.0/uk/
Changes: audio extracted from MP4, the surrounding VCV context removed for
consonants, steady vowels shortened, level normalised, fades and silence padding
added, and encoded as mono 44.1 kHz PCM WAV.

University of Salford Harvard speech corpus — edited, end-pointed, zero-padded
Dataset author: Philippa Demonte; recorded with a female native British English
speaker.
Source: https://salford.figshare.com/articles/dataset/Speech_corpus_-_Harvard_-_edited_end-pointed_zero-padded_audio/7862186
Licence: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 International
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/
Changes: contiguous sound excerpts selected from recorded words, resampled to
mono 44.1 kHz PCM WAV, level normalised, and short fades/silence padding added.

The resulting audio pack is restricted to noncommercial use under its source
licences. This notice does not apply one licence to ToSpeech's own source code.
